path.data-subject-role: Plain bar-magnet component boundary, not a full single-magnet field lesson. Pole territories are semantic, not physical cut seams.
Externally taught pole-identity key: one line=N, two lines=S. Instructional line bands, not physical grooves, visible N/S letters, Braille or field/force vectors.
